ui.titleLineTwo: then build for the long run.
ui.description: Take a moment to choose your basics and start keeping track of your investments. Stock data and AI can be added whenever you are ready.
ui.calloutDescription: Finish the basics to start using Portwise. Stock data and AI can be added later whenever you need them.

activeStep.preferencesDescription: Pick your language and theme so Portwise feels right every time you use it.
activeStep.preferencesHint: Your choices are saved automatically and can be changed anytime.
activeStep.portfolioDescription: Name your portfolio, then add the stocks you want to follow over time.
activeStep.stockDescription: Connect a data service so Portwise can sync stock profiles, market data, dividends, and financials. Start with FTShare, and add other services as they become available.
activeStep.inferenceDescription: Choose services and models for conversations and smart search, or come back to this later.

fields.portfolioHint: Add several stocks now, and adjust your list whenever you need to.

portfolio.stockSectionDescription: Enter each code, exchange, and current holding. You can update them later.
portfolio.stockEmpty: No stocks added yet. Start with one you follow.

stock.title: Stock data services
stock.description: Choose a data service and enter its access key. You can still enter Portwise without one; stock data will be ready after you configure a service.
stock.providerSectionDescription: Each service has its own access key. New services will appear here as they are added.
stock.providersUnavailableTitle: The service list is temporarily unavailable
stock.providersEmpty: No data services are available yet. You can skip this step and return to Settings later.
stock.ftShareDescription: FTShare provides stock profiles, market data, dividends, and financial information.
stock.genericProviderDescription: This service can provide stock data for Portwise.
stock.keyHint: Your access key is encrypted and used only to retrieve stock data.
stock.loadError: The available services could not be loaded right now. You can skip this step and configure one later in Settings.
stock.futureProviderHint: Set up only the service you want to use now. All stock data services will be managed here as more become available.

inference.title: AI assistant
inference.description: Optional. Choose separate services and models for conversations and smart search.
inference.providerSectionDescription: Choose only the services you need. Conversations and smart search can use different services.
inference.providersUnavailableTitle: The AI service list is temporarily unavailable
inference.providersEmpty: No AI services are available yet. You can finish setup and add one later in Settings.
inference.routesDescription: Choose a service and model for conversations and smart search separately.
inference.chatDescription: Used for conversations and interactive answers.
inference.embeddingDescription: Used for knowledge retrieval and smart search.
inference.credentialsDescription: Only selected services appear here, so you only need to enter the keys you will use.
inference.credentialsEmptyDescription: Select a service for conversations or smart search above, and its access key field will appear here.
inference.baseUrlHint: Azure OpenAI and custom services use the address provided by your service.
inference.keyHint: Access keys are encrypted and only used to connect to the selected AI service.
inference.loadError: The AI service list could not be loaded. You can skip this step and configure one later in Settings.
inference.hint: You can skip this for now and add it later in Settings.
inference.validation: Fill in a service and its model to use AI, or leave both for later.

ui.footer: You can change these choices anytime in Settings.

validation.portfolio: Give your portfolio a name first.
validation.stockCode: The stock code must contain six digits.
validation.heldShares: Held shares must be a whole number of 0 or more.
validation.inference: Fill in each AI service and its model, or leave them all for later.
validation.inferenceRoute: Choose a service and enter its model, or leave this capability for later.

states.errorTitle: We could not save that just yet
states.saveError: Something went wrong while saving. Check the fields and try again.

initialization_validation_failed.title: A few details need another look
initialization_validation_failed.detail: Review the language, theme, portfolio, stock details, and service information, then try again.

initialization_already_completed.title: You are all set
initialization_already_completed.detail: This workspace is already set up, so there is nothing else to submit here.

initialization_not_completed.title: A little setup is still needed
initialization_not_completed.detail: Finish the basics before continuing with Portwise.
